jobs.description:
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

To strengthen our Supply Chain Team we are looking for a Configuration & Logistics Officer who ensures that for a given engine, the pieces are made available for assembly within the configuration and timeframe agreed with the customer.Your role:

• You will analyse and provide the logistical needs to complete the engine.
• You read and understand the logistical aspects of the Bill of Work for the engine.
• You detect critical points in the completion process and look for an appropriate solution to achieve the objectives (e.g. Standard Exchanges, switches between different engines).
• You direct your internal suppliers (warehouse, backshop, subcontracting, purchasing).
• You complete the modules and ensure that they are prepared according to the predetermined production planning.
• You support the assembly line with missing and/or defective parts.
• You analyse the interchangeability (technical and qualitative) of pieces, in accordance with the established configuration.

Your profile:

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain or a technical direction, or equivalent through experience.
• You have an interest in aircraft engines and want to learn more about them.
• You are communicative and dare to ask questions.
• You work in a structured, accurate and proactive way.
• You work analytically and come up with practical solutions.
• You organize, divide and control your work independently.
• You speak French or Dutch, you also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• Experience with SAP is a plus.
• You work in shifts, from Monday to Friday (6 am - 2 pm, 2 pm - 10 pm).
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

As experienced CNC machine operator, you will oversee our computer numeric controlled (CNC) machines. You will be responsible for ensuring machining of subassembly, quality parts and tools specific to engineering drawings dimensions.

Your Role:

• Set up and operate CNC machines to perform various tasks, including drilling, grinding, and milling.
• Ensure CNC machines operate in compliance with company guidelines and safety standards.
• Monitor machines during operation and make necessary adjustments to optimize results.
• Inspect machinery daily to ensure proper functionality.
• Record all machine activities by completing production and quality logs.
• Provide accurate timelines and updates to clients.
• Communicate with the Methods Department regarding any issues encountered during machining.
• Ensure that machining results meet the defined work scope and quality expectations.
• Conduct regular assessments and maintenance of CNC machines.

Your Profile:

• High school diploma or equivalent qualification required.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience as a CNC machine operator.
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical documents and engineering drawings.
• Strong mechanical aptitude.
• Excellent attention to detail and a goal-oriented attitude.
• Strong comprehension and analytical skills.
• Knowledge of the latest equipment and techniques in the industry.
• Good computer skills.
• You have a very knowledge of technical English and a basic understanding of Dutch or French, with the desire to improve it.
• Willingness to work in a 3-shift system

The Logistic Warehouse Officer is responsible for the physical flow, the IT flow and the traceability of parts and modules in the preparation area before assembly and in the warehouse. He works in a production environment and reports to the Completion Manager, who in turn reports to the Supply Chain Director.Your role:

• You strive to become fully operational and autonomous within six months, following a period of training and learning.
• You possess strong communication skills, practical thinking, and initiative, while actively contributing to continuous improvement efforts.
• You are a team player with an open and adaptable mindset.
• You work in a two-shift system: one week from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m., followed by a week from 2 p.m. to 10 p.m.

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Data Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
Oliver James is partnering with a leading enterprise organization migrating its core legacy systems from Adabas (Mainframe) to PostgreSQL.

We are seeking a Data Functional Analyst to bridge the gap between legacy business logic and modern database architecture. Working directly alongside Data Engineers and DBAs, you will define data mappings and ensure a seamless, high-integrity migration.
Key responsibilities

• 
Legacy Data Analysis & Mapping: Deep-dive into Mainframe data structures and define accurate functional target mappings to PostgreSQL relational schemaq

• 
Technical & Functional Guidance: Act as the primary functional advisor for Data Engineers and DBAs, writing clear functional specifications to guide ETL/ELT pipeline development and schema design

• 
Data Quality & Reconciliation: Design data validation strategies, define test scenarios, and execute cross-database reconciliation checks (Mainframe legacy vs. PostgreSQL) to guarantee 100% data integrity and consistency

• 
Data Lineage & Documentation: Maintain comprehensive data dictionaries, mapping rulebooks, and lineage documentation throughout the migration lifecycle

• 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the functional point of contact for resolving legacy data ambiguities and translating complex business rules for the technical delivery team

• 
Functional Data Expertise: 3 years of experience as a Data Functional Analyst, Business Data Analyst, or Data Consultant on large-scale data transformation projects

• 
Database & SQL Skills: Strong, mandatory expertise in PostgreSQL and advanced proficiency in SQL and relational data modelling concepts

• 
Mainframe Experience: Solid functional understanding of Mainframe database environments (knowledge of Adabas is nice to have, but not mandatory)

• 
Migration Track Record: Hands-on experience working on complex legacy-to-relational data migration projects

• 
Language skills

• 
Fluent English (written and spoken)

• 
Professional fluency in French and/or Dutch (essential for local team and business stakeholder collaboration)

• 
Communication & Mindset: Excellent analytical skills, rigorous attention to detail, and the ability to articulate complex functional rules clearly to technical teams

Join Magnax as a Mechanical Design Engineer – Robotics and help shape compact, high-performance actuators. You'll translate demanding motion requirements into manufacturable mechanical designs.
 
 

• Design mechanical solutions for robotic systems, from concept to production. 

• Create 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, applying industry standards and GD&T. 

• Perform mechanical calculations and design verification for performance, reliability, and durability. 

• Work with suppliers and subcontractors on components, processes, tolerances, materials, and specs. 

• Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and design improvements. 

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in the design and development of robotic systems, actuators, or precision motion systems.
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM, or similar CAD/PDM tools.
   
 

•  

Strong understanding of robotics system requirements and performance specifications, with the ability to translate payload, speed, torque, force, power, accuracy and duty cycle into mechanical design requirements.
   
 

•  

Strong awareness of the latest trends and technologies in robotics, with a good understanding of emerging robotic architectures, actuation technologies, and motion solutions.
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium.
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent English.

Magnax is looking for an experienced Electromagnetic Simulations Engineer to join our growing team. You’ll own the electromagnetic simulations of our axial flux motors and inverters.
 

What you’ll do:

• Analyse results to assess performance and spot improvements 

• Refine simulation methods to shorten development time and improve correlation with test data 

• Work with simulation, mechanical and prototyping engineers to optimise motor design 

• Carry out root cause analysis on products and processes.
For a full description of the job description, please visit our careers page: https://traxial.com/careers 

 
 
 

• Master’s in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, or equivalent experience 

• 2+ years of hands-on electromagnetic simulation experience 

• Proficient in Ansys Maxwell, JMAG, Altair (or similar) and Python 

• Basic knowledge of mechanics, NVH and thermodynamics 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 

• Fluent English and a collaborative team player

Magnax builds next-generation electric motors based on yokeless axial flux technology. They are compact, light and efficient, which makes them a strong match for robotics. We're a team of about 30 people in Kortrijk, mostly engineers from many countries. We work in English and move fast from idea to prototype.
 

As Applications Engineer, you are the technical link between our customers, the market and our R&D team.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Act as first technical contact for customer inquiries and find out what they really need. 

• Translate customer specs (RFIs/RFQs) into motor requirements with R&D, and select the right motor solution. 

• Build proposals, including pricing, and follow up until the project is won. 

• Track the robotics market and identify where axial flux motors bring the most value. 

• Report insights to management to guide product and commercial choices. 

• Support datasheets and sales tools, share customer feedback with R&D, and join customer visits and trade fairs. For a more detailed description of the job requirements, please visit our careers page: www.traxial.com/careers 

Who we’re looking for
 
 

• Master’s in electromechanical, electrical, mechanical or mechatronics engineering 

• At least 2 years in robotics (actuators, cobots, industrial robots, humanoids, AMRs) 

• Solid knowledge of electric drive systems: motors, gearboxes, controllers 

• Strong with customers: you ask the right questions and write clear proposals 

• Analytical: you turn market information into actionable insights 

• Independent, with ownership of technical solutions 

• Fluent English; other languages are a plus 

• Open to occasional travel  

You report to the Belgian management team.
